title: District court case status and CNR search
use: Check the hearing date, stage, history and available orders. Search with a CNR or select the state, district and court for other search options.
need: CNR; or case number and year, party name or other available search details.

title: Punjab and Haryana High Court
use: Use the official Case Status, Orders, Judgments, Cause List and Display Board menus for your High Court matter.
need: Case type, number and year, or other search particulars offered by the court.

title: High Courts eCourts services
use: Look up case status, orders and judgments through the High Courts services portal.
need: Select the High Court and use the appropriate case-search option.

title: Supreme Court case information
use: Find Case Status, daily orders, judgments and cause lists on the Supreme Court's official website.
need: Diary number and year, or case type, number and year.

title: Chandigarh District Courts
use: Find court notices, holidays, court information and links to case status and cause lists.
need: Court or case particulars for the service you choose.

title: SAS Nagar Mohali District Courts
use: Find the district court's official notices, court information and daily-board or cause-list section.
need: Court name or case particulars. SAS Nagar is the district name used for Mohali.

title: Panchkula District Courts
use: Access the official district court website and its court information and notices.
need: Court or case particulars.

title: High Court daily cause lists
use: Read the High Court's daily cause-list system and check the applicable supplementary lists.
need: Hearing date and case particulars; verify bench, court and item number.

title: Consumer commission case history
use: Look up consumer complaint history and status on the official e-Jagriti platform.
need: Commission and the new case number, filing reference or legacy reference supported by the portal.

title: Consumer complaint filing and portal help
use: Access consumer case filing, cause lists, orders and help through the government platform.
need: Registered account for filing, correct commission and the required case documents.

title: Court e-filing services
use: Register and use the official electronic filing services for courts that have adopted the platform.
need: Account, selected court, prepared documents and its current filing requirements.

title: Court fee and judicial payments
use: Choose the relevant court-payment service on the official ePay portal.
need: Court, payment purpose and reference details. Confirm the correct payment head before paying.

title: Virtual Courts challans
use: Check eligible challans and use the payment or contest option provided for the selected virtual court.
need: Select the jurisdiction and use the supported challan, vehicle or other search particulars.

title: Punjab RERA complaint status
use: Check available complaint status information on the authority's official website.
need: Complaint or diary particulars supported by the search.

title: Punjab RERA cause list
use: Check listed complaint hearings and the stated purpose of hearing.
need: Complaint number, party name and listing date.

title: Punjab RERA orders
use: Access the authority's orders and judgments and the relevant adjudication sections.
need: Complaint particulars or the name and date of the order.

title: NCLT case status
use: Search the tribunal's case-status service for the selected bench, including Chandigarh matters.
need: Bench and case particulars requested by the portal.

title: NCLT cause lists
use: Select the bench and date to find the relevant cause list.
need: Bench, court, date and case particulars.

title: DRT and DRAT case status
use: Use the official DRT and DRAT case-status report.
need: Select tribunal and supply the requested case details.

title: DRT electronic filing
use: Access tribunal e-filing and official user manuals.
need: Registration, tribunal, case type and prepared documents.

title: Supreme Court judgment search
use: Search Supreme Court judgments through the court's official search service.
need: Case names, keywords, dates or other available search fields.

title: India Code statutes
use: Find Acts and statutory provisions in the official legislation database.
need: Act name, year or section. Check amendments and commencement relevant to your issue.

title: NALSA legal aid information
use: Read the official legal-aid information and routes for applying. National legal-aid helpline: 15100.
need: Basic details of the legal issue and documents requested by the authority.

title: Apply for legal aid or submit a grievance
use: Open the official Legal Services Management System application form.
need: Applicant details, relevant eligibility information and case particulars.

title: eCourts mobile app help
use: Read official help for the app's case and court services.
need: Choose the app feature or question relevant to your task.
